verdict.rationale: Rippling's first-party Global Payroll docs say it pays employees and contractors worldwide in one system and calculates and files payroll taxes for employees worldwide. A customer quote describes running all three of its countries in one system, which covers paying people abroad through global payroll. Missing for 10: any explicit employer-of-record offering, explicit confirmation that payroll runs through owned local entities, a country-coverage list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of international employment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can employ people in other countries through employer-of-record or owned-entity global payroll

citations.quote: Pay employees and contractors around the world in a single system
